summary: This is a fake remote job that impersonates Amazon to get you to pay $450 for 'equipment' before you start. The money goes to the scammers and the reimbursement never comes.
tactics: Two-hour deadline to stop you checking
questionsToAsk: Can you send this offer from an @amazon.com email address?
What is the job ID on amazon.jobs so I can apply there directly?
Can we schedule a video interview with the hiring manager?
howToVerify: Search the role yourself on amazon.jobs instead of using their link
Never buy equipment for a new job; real employers ship it to you
